title: Daily Director directional threshold root-cause and durable repair
objective: Reproduce and resolve the current Daily Director API_OUTPUT_INVALID failure where both attempts fail with directional_pct_threshold_required. Determine whether the defect is in prompt/schema contract alignment, parser validation, candidate materialization, or model-output shaping, then implement the smallest deterministic repair without relaxing forecast semantics, fabricating thresholds, or allowing invalid API output to pass silently.

origin.thread_label: 2026-08-28 daily evidence and accountability health watch
source_paths: directly related Daily Director prompt/schema/parser code

evidence.summary: Latest Daily Director workflow run is failed with failure_streak 10 in fresh Automation Health.
API_AGENT_RECEIPT_v3 is deterministic API_OUTPUT_INVALID after two attempts; both parse errors are ValueError:directional_pct_threshold_required.
Blob SHA of the concrete failure receipt used for fresh reproduction.
Existing CODEX_READY repeated-failure task to deduplicate against rather than create a competing health remediation.

allowed_change_scope: research/api_agent/directly related Daily Director prompt, schema and parser code
scripts/directly related Daily Director forecast candidate validation/materialization code
tests/directly related Daily Director contract tests
forbidden_changes: inventing or defaulting a directional percentage threshold without existing contract authority
weakening required forecast fields merely to make parsing pass
converting invalid API output into PASS
reproduction: On fresh main, inspect run 33125328450 and replay the current Daily Director schema/parser path against the immutable output/receipt pair from 2026-08-27T15:26:27Z. Trace where directional_pct_threshold is required, how the prompt instructs the model to emit it, whether the generated candidate omits it or represents it under a mismatched field/target-mode contract, and whether retries can ever repair the structural mismatch. Stop as clean no-op if a newer natural run succeeds and the exact failure no longer reproduces.

positive: A valid directional forecast candidate produced under the existing canonical contract includes an explicitly authorized directional percentage threshold and passes parser validation.
A non-directional candidate is not forced to invent a directional threshold when the existing contract does not require one.
A natural or production-shaped Daily Director run can complete with a valid API_AGENT_RECEIPT_v3 and no directional_pct_threshold_required parse error.
Forecast creation remains bound to current Task 4 metric-path and target-unit contracts.
negative: Missing required directional threshold remains API_OUTPUT_INVALID and cannot silently pass.
No numeric fallback/default threshold may be synthesized unless already defined by an authoritative existing contract.
Parser/schema compatibility repair cannot alter market thresholds, scoring semantics or portfolio action.
Retries cannot hide a deterministic schema mismatch by accepting structurally invalid output.

clean_noop_condition: A newer natural Daily Director run succeeds under the same contract and fresh reproduction shows the directional threshold mismatch is already fixed or superseded.
stop_condition: Stop without implementation if the health precondition clears, the exact failure cannot be reproduced, or resolution requires changing market thresholds or canonical forecast semantics.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if the only resolution requires a new market threshold, changed forecast semantics, model-weight changes, portfolio logic, or API-budget expansion.
rollback_plan: Revert only bounded Daily Director prompt/schema/parser/workflow changes. Preserve deterministic API_OUTPUT_INVALID receipts and immutable prior outputs.
